messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — P1 Elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/stream (hosted). 5xx rose from 0.2% to ~12% in 7m. Paging @oncall. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/graph?panelId=stream-5xx :rotating_light:
Maya (oncall): ack, I'm on it. joining traces now :eyes:
Maya (oncall): initial check — gateway (edge-proxy) is returning a bunch of 502/504 to clients, origin responses to gateway show truncated bodies or connection resets
Jon (infra): seeing same. nginx logs on edge show 'upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream' and a lot of 'connection reset by peer' from streamer pods
Simone (infra): tailing streamer stdout — there are repeated errors like `write: broken pipe` when sending chunked responses. also a handful of OOMKilled events on newer streamer revision 2026.03.12-rc6
Amir (sre): customer impact estimate?
Maya (oncall): preliminary: ~8% of streaming sessions had an early disconnect; some canceled client-side streams. enterprise customers intermittently reported timeouts. CS bot pinged for notifications
Customer Success Bot: Notified customers: AcmeCorp, NovaApps, RidgeAI; sent interim advisory with status and workaround (switch to non-streaming endpoint).
Jon (infra): running quick inventory
```
kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=streamer -o wide
# streamer-1 Running  2/2  10.1.2.5
# streamer-2 CrashLoopBackOff 0/2 10.1.2.6
# streamer-3 Running  2/2  10.1.2.7
```
Maya (oncall): streamer-2 is flapping, correlates to spike window. could be bad build or kernel-level NIC flaps
Simone (infra): plan: 1) scale streamer to handle in-flight backlog 2) route streaming traffic to healthy pool 3) enable fallback to non-streaming sync endpoint for affected customer routes 4) collect core/dumps from crashed pods
Jon (infra): applying scale now: `kubectl scale deploy/streamer --replicas=8 -n prod` — doing staged scale to avoid thundering herd
deploy-bot: Rollout initiated: streamer replicas -> 8 (canary mode)
Maya (oncall): also increasing gateway upstream timeout and keepalive thresholds to reduce premature closes. running `proxyctl route update --path /v1/stream --upstream-timeout 60s` now
Simone (infra): pushed edge config bump. patched NGINX to allow larger chunk buffer and keepalive.
Simone (infra): collecting logs and a sample of truncated responses, uploading to S3: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1958883333/
Amir (sre): capturing pprof and core dumps from streamer-2; will attach links in postmortem
```
[2026-03-15T19:07:12Z] streamer-2 stderr: ERROR: write: broken pipe while streaming chunk to client id=abc123
[2026-03-15T19:07:12Z] edge-proxy nginx: 502 upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client=10.5.6.7, server=api.redwood
```
Maya (oncall): scaled to 8; error rate starting to fall from 12% -> 4.7% in last 3m. monitoring traces for backlog drain
Jon (infra): confirming traffic rebalanced away from flapping pods. also rolled streamer-2 to previous stable image 2026.03.05 as quick rollback
deploy-bot: Rollback complete: streamer image -> 2026.03.05 on streamer-2
Maya (oncall): enabling sync fallback route for heavy customers to avoid streaming until we confirm stability (will route to /v1/generate). patching routing rules now
Jon (infra): temporary mitigation set. gateway now returning 202 + polling style for fallback customers if streaming fails
Maya (oncall): error rate now 1.6% and trending down. customer-visible errors mostly timeouts/early disconnects — no evidence of corrupted content, just truncation
Customer Success Bot: Sent update to affected customers with ETA 30m for full mitigation and workaround instructions.
Amir (sre): starting deeper dive: looking at memory/alloc patterns in streamer around chunk flush. suspect a regression in chunked-encoder buffer handling introduced in rc6
Simone (infra): will run a controlled canary of rc6 with extra instrumentation on staging to reproduce chunk truncation before next deploy
Maya (oncall): oncall handoff scheduled in 40m to night team. leaving notes: scaled streamer -> 8, edge keepalive + timeout bumped, rollback on flapping pod, sync fallback enabled for heavy customers, collecting cores/logs.
Jon (infra): created follow-up tickets: INF-2412 revert chunked encoder change, INF-2413 add streaming integration test for partial-frame resilience, INF-2414 gateway hold-open metrics & alarms
Maya (oncall): postmortem owner: Amir (sre). CS follow-up owner: Simone (infra). Target postmortem draft in 48h.
Amir (sre): attaching initial artifacts: traces, pprof links, core dumps (s3 paths), and a small repro harness snippet in the repo.
Maya (oncall): marking incident as MITIGATED for customer impact at the moment. keeping channel open for any regressions. final error rate at mitigation: 0.9%
Simone (infra): will coordinate root-cause verification tomorrow morning and schedule a controlled canary of the fixed encoder
Maya (oncall): thanks everyone. handing off to night oncall @NightShift. Please escalate to P1 if error rate creeps >3% again. :thumbsup:
NightShift (temp): acked, monitoring.
Maya (oncall): closing live mitigation phase — moving to post-incident tasks.
